title: Deck Atlas
summary: Offline maps on the deck: your MBTiles, PMTiles and tile folders.
description: Offline maps: import MBTiles or PMTiles files, or a z/x/y tile folder, then pan and zoom by touch or keys. An optional USB GPS (listen-only) shows your position, with follow mode, and writes position.state for other apps; off until switched on. Online sources (OpenTopoMap, Thunderforest, Geoapify with your key) stay off until you accept their terms; never the OSM Foundation's servers. 480x320 and up (320x480 in PDA mode).
depends: libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libsqlite3-0, libcurl4t64, ca-certificates
